key_insight: In SMAW of AISI/SAE 1020 mild steel, the quenching medium dominates joint performance far more than groove angle, and air cooling gives the best overall toughness and strain-hardening behavior.
engineering_relevance: For weld design and post-weld treatment, selecting the cooling medium is the main lever for improving mechanical response, while groove angle is a secondary tuning parameter.
method: Normalised Type III effect-share analysis to quantify factor importance across six mechanical responses
Four multi-criteria decision methods: entropy-weighted GRA, equal-weight GRA, TOPSIS, and Derringer–Suich desirability
Machine-learning surrogates and functional ANOVA on recovered stress–strain data
evidence_signal: The abstract reports quenching medium explains about 70.3–94.6% of the estimated effect versus 4.4–25.7% for groove angle, and all four ranking methods produced the same ordering.
watch_item: The conclusions depend on reconstructed tensile records and the tested 55–60° groove range, so broader validation on other steels, weld setups, and cooling conditions is still needed.
paper_title: Groove angle and quenching medium in shielded metal arc welding of mild steel: Multi-criteria decision analysis, machine learning and energy absorption
